headline: Analysts Warn State Buying Insufficient to Sustain China Stock Rally
summary: State entity buying helped drive the CSI 300 Index up, but analysts warned that intervention will be insufficient to engineer a durable rally in China's stock market amid weak earnings growth.
why: State interventions in equity markets provide short-term price support but rarely resolve underlying macroeconomic and corporate earnings pressures.

impacts.name: CSI 300 Index
impacts.why: Persistent structural weaknesses and slow corporate earnings offset the short-term impact of state-backed ETF purchases.

why_moved: Sustained market rallies require organic earnings growth rather than temporary state liquidity injections.
